uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-tool-status.text: Started a class diagram with a class, an interface, and a realization.

after.properties:
- region "Class — Class":
  - heading "Class — Class" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Name (id)
  - textbox "Name (id)": Class
  - text: Kind
  - combobox "Kind":
    - option "Class" [selected]
    - option "Abstract Class"
    - option "Interface"
    - option "Enum"
  - text: Stereotype (e.g. <<service>>)
  - textbox "Stereotype (e.g. <<service>>)"
  - text: Highlight color (#hex or color name)
  - textbox "Highlight color (#hex or color name)"
  - text: Texture
  - combobox "Texture":
    - option "None" [selected]
    - option "Hatched"
    - option "Crosshatch"
    - option "Dotted"
    - option "Grid"
    - option "Striped"
  - group "Members":
    - text: Members
    - button "+ Add Member"
  - button "Add teaching callout"
